findings.evidence: `rg -n "relativeProdHom_apply_apply"` finds the declaration at `Prod.lean:138`; lines 141-143 show the actual lhs is `Prod.map ... x = ...`, unlike `prodHom_apply_apply` at lines 77-79, which applies `prodHom` itself.
findings.fix: Change the left-hand side to apply `relativeProdHom`, e.g. `(relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x = ((p.1 : _) x.1, (p.2 : _) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is documented and named as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its statement only proves the definitional identity for `Prod.map`; downstream users cannot rewrite `(relativeProdHom s t p : _) x` with this theorem.

summary: One advertised pointwise API theorem for the relative product homomorphism is mis-formalized: it never mentions the relative product homomorphism.
